name: g8e
description: Puts Claude Code on the g8e governed path: the g8e Gateway MCP server is the only way to act, and every other tool is denied.

g8e_root.title: g8e root
g8e_root.description: Directory that contains your .g8e/ runtime (where you ran 'g8e gw start' and enrolled). The MCP bridge runs from here.

g8e_binary.title: g8e binary
g8e_binary.description: Path to the g8e binary, or a name on PATH.

app_name.title: Application identity
app_name.description: Enrolled application name the bridge authenticates as ('g8e auth enroll app <name>'). Receipts record it as spiffe://g8e.local/app/<name>.
